summary: Permian Basin Royalty Trust filed an 8-K solely to announce a change in the time of a scheduled court hearing (from 10:30 a.m. to 9:30 a.m. CT) on May 8, 2026, before the 96th District Court of Tarrant County. The hearing relates to a petition filed by unitholder SoftVest seeking judicial modification of the trust indenture. No financial terms, deal consideration, or transaction mechanics are disclosed. This is a procedural scheduling update, not a special-situation event. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. It is a routine current report and thus classified as None.
